title: Request body to create a test payment

anyOf.title: Test payment for a registered member

memberId.description: The identifier of the member who should be associated with this payment. This value corresponds to the `origin.memberId` provided during member registration.

useNewCard.description: This will simulate the member registering a new card and will trigger corresponding event NEW_REGISTERED_CARD

anyOf.title: Test payment for a returning non-member

memberReference.description: The identifier of the non-member. This value corresponds to the `memberReference` attribute returned when a test payment was made for a non-member.

locationId.description: Tyro Connect's identifier for the location.

paymentType.description: The type of payment being made

paymentSource.description: The method used to make the payment

goodsAndServicesAmount.description: The amount paid for goods and services

tipAmount.description: The amount paid as part of a tip

surchargeAmount.description: The amount paid as part of a surcharge

cashoutAmount.description: The amount paid as part of a cash withdrawal
